title: eBay Live lead discovery
description: Discover public eBay Live hosts/sellers. No login or private-contact collection.

searchQueries.title: Live keywords
searchQueries.description: Optional keywords used as evidence labels for public eBay Live discovery URLs.

startUrls.title: eBay Live URLs
startUrls.description: Optional public eBay Live event, channel, or browse URLs.

sellerUsernames.title: Known seller usernames
sellerUsernames.description: Optional public eBay usernames to enrich directly in addition to Live discovery.

country.title: Discovery marketplace
country.description: eBay Live site used to discover candidates. Defaults to United Kingdom; use sellerCountries to filter seller location independently.

sellerCountries.title: Host countries or region
sellerCountries.description: Optional seller-country filter. Enter ISO codes such as DE or FR; enter EU to include all 27 European Union member states. Country is verified from the public About page before output.

maxProfileEnrichmentHosts.title: Maximum profiles to enrich
maxProfileEnrichmentHosts.description: Maximum public seller profiles opened after Live discovery to collect feedback rate, sold count, follower count and location. For country or EU filtering, set this above the requested output count so enough verified matches can be returned.

minFollowerCount.title: Minimum public followers
minFollowerCount.description: Exclude hosts below this published follower count.

includeEndedLives.title: Include ended/replay lives
includeEndedLives.description: Include public ended and replay sessions as evidence.

enrichProfiles.title: Enrich public seller profiles
enrichProfiles.description: Visit each selected public seller profile once to collect public feedback rate, items sold, followers and location.

profileEnrichmentMode.title: Profile enrichment provider
profileEnrichmentMode.description: Auto uses Bright Data Web Unlocker when BRIGHT_DATA_API_KEY is configured, otherwise direct browser. Bright Data requires a separately billed Web Unlocker zone.

maxProfileConcurrency.title: Profile concurrency
maxProfileConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrent public seller profile pages.

maxRequestRetries.title: Retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Maximum retry count for a failed public page.

navigationTimeoutSecs.title: Page timeout
navigationTimeoutSecs.description: Seconds allowed for one public page.

dedupeStoreName.title: State store
dedupeStoreName.description: Reserved named store for cross-run state.
